## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new content
- [ ] `fix` — correction of an error
- [ ] `docs` — wording, structure or links only
- [ ] `refactor` / `style` — no change in meaning
- [ ] `ci` / `build` / `chore` — tooling & maintenance
